title: Discovery of 3-(Arylamido)pyrazolopyridine HIF-2alpha Agonists and a Codrug Strategy with Prolyl Hydroxylase Inhibition for Synergistic Treatment of Renal Anemia.
authors: Gao, Yinli; Yang, Qingyun; Liu, Simeng; Liu, Jiaming; Chen, Liwei; Bao, Xiaoqian; Zhang, Linjian; Yang, Le; Yang, Fulai; Li, Xiang; Wu, Yue; Zhang, Xiaojin
one_liner_zh: 该文发现HIF-2α激动剂并设计共药，虽用MD模拟蛋白-配体结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Activation of the hypoxia-inducible factor-2 (HIF-2) pathway represents a promising strategy for the treatment of renal anemia. Here, we identify compound 48 (ZG-2686), a 3-(benzamido)pyrazolopyridine derivative, as a novel and potent HIF-2alpha agonist (E(max) = 375.7 +/- 9.7%, EC(50) = 0.25 +/- 0.05 muM). Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provided detailed insights into the binding mode of 48 with the HIF-2alpha/beta complex. In cellular assays, 48 synergistically enhanced HIF-2alpha-dependent EPO gene expression when combined with the clinically approved prolyl hydroxylase domain (PHD) inhibitor Vadadustat. To further exploit this synergy, we designed and synthesized the bifunctional codrug 50 (ZG-2688), linking 48 with Vadadustat. Notably, codrug 50 induced superior upregulation of EPO levels in vivo compared to coadministration of the two individual agents. Together, these findings demonstrate the first rationally designed codrug integrating an HIF-2alpha agonist and a PHD inhibitor, highlighting a new direction for the development of renal anemia therapies.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-2（HIF-2）通路的激活是治疗肾性贫血的一种有前景的策略。在此，我们鉴定出化合物48（ZG-2686），一种3-(苯甲酰胺基)吡唑并吡啶衍生物，作为一种新型且强效的HIF-2α激动剂（E(max) = 375.7 ± 9.7%，EC(50) = 0.25 ± 0.05 μM）。分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟提供了48与HIF-2α/β复合物结合模式的详细见解。在细胞实验中，48与临床批准的脯氨酰羟化酶结构域（prolyl hydroxylase domain, PHD）抑制剂Vadadustat联合使用时，协同增强了HIF-2α依赖性EPO基因表达。为进一步利用这种协同作用，我们设计并合成了双功能共药50（ZG-2688），将48与Vadadustat连接。值得注意的是，与两种单独药物联合给药相比，共药50在体内诱导了更优的EPO水平上调。综上所述，这些发现展示了首个合理设计的整合HIF-2α激动剂和PHD抑制剂的共药，为肾性贫血治疗的发展指明了新方向。
